title: Ponk yu kawe yi ci dun yi ngelaw li di yóbbu
intro: Xalaatal benn siwilisasioŋ buy yokku, am doole ju rëy ak mën tabax bu amul fenn. Dëkkandoo yi dañu dëkk ci diggu ay dun yu yaatu, ñu defar ay landmark yu mag yuy laal asamaan. Waaye réy-réy dafa jëm ca kanam, ñu bañ ko woote ñu dellu ci jaamu Yàlla kese. Li ci topp mooy àrtu bi ngelaw li ci boppam yóbbaale.
clues: Nun xeet wu am doole lanu woon, ginaaw askanu Nuh, nu barkeel ci jëmm ju rëy ak doole.
Tabax nanu tour yu kawe ak monumaa ci barab bu kawe bu nekk ngir tàggat yaram ak mbégte.
Danuy gëna réy, di wax kan moo nu gëna am doole ci doole, te nuy jaay doole, te amul yërmaande.
Weddi nanu sunu yonent Huud ba mu nuy woo nu jaamu Yàlla rekk, ne ko ku néew doole ku fenkat la.
Nu ñaawal àrtu bi, ba noppi nu wax ko mu indil nu mbugal mimu nu doon tiital sudee dëgg lay wax.
Ngelaw lu metti la nu yàq ci diiru juróom ñaari guddi ak juróom ñatti fan, nu daanu ni garabi palm yu lëndëm.

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful." (46:22)
